metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the stall, the quire, the names in the tiring-house, and the paying.

yesterday: Four galleys. Mousehole, Newlyn, Penzance, and the church at Paul on the hill. Plymouth was the yard's addition.
The hired men were paid a week owing, and five shillings, the first of the half-wages. The book says dark till Bartholomew. You played today.
You walk on Monday. The walk saves eighteen shillings of horse-hire. The Verona sheets go with you.
